title: 第17章 城主府巴结第18章 血杀到来
slug: 刚穿越就继承了宗主之位
lines: “秦宗主，城主此次派小的过来，除了送礼之外，有更加重要的事情要通知秦宗主。”管家说道。
“什么事？”秦叶微微点头，不置可否。
“清风城将在七日后举行宗门排名大赛，城主特地让小的人来通知秦宗主参加。”管家说道。
宗门排名大赛，秦叶自然知道，上一次宗门排名大赛，清风宗就是垫底，后来更是被六大宗门踢出来。
算算时间还有两年时间才会举办，怎么会提前呢？
“城主有没有说提前举行的原因？”秦叶问道。
“城主没有说，不过这是阳陵侯传下来的手令，城主也只能遵从。”管家回答道。
秦叶微微点头，阳陵侯此人他听说过，是大秦王朝赫赫有名的战将，因战功受封阳陵侯，清风城就属于阳陵侯管辖。
至于是什么原因让阳陵侯传下侯令，这对于秦叶来说并不重要，只要不惹他就行，若是敢惹他，他会教他怎么做人，即使是手握实权的侯爷也不行。
宗门排名大赛是针对30岁以下的年轻弟子参赛，城主府与参赛宗门会设置下丰厚的奖励，这对于其他宗门来说或许是一次不错的历练，但是对于清风宗来说却不是。
那点奖励，秦叶根本看不上。
所以，秦叶直接开口拒绝：“本座知道了，麻烦管家跑这一趟了，我清风宗不会参……”
当秦叶说到这里的时候，突然系统提示声响起。
“叮，新任务激活，请宿主带领门中弟子参加宗门排名大赛夺得第一。任务奖励十个盲盒。”
秦叶身体顿时一震，十个盲盒这肯定能抽出好东西，不就是宗门排名大赛吗？想拿第一，有什么难的。
这宗门排名大赛第一名，他要了。
谁来都没用。
"秦宗主，你刚才的话还未讲完，还请继续。"
管家恭敬地说道。
“本座说的是，宗门排名大赛，我清风宗一定会去的，而且还要拿第一。”秦叶回过神来，改口说道。
你刚刚好像不是这么说的。
“小的就祝清风宗马到成功，心想事成了。”管家恭贺道，心中却是有些不以为然。
秦叶虽为先天强者，但是清风宗什么情况，外面早就打听清楚了。整个清风宗就那么几个人，而弟子也就只有一名，还是刚刚收的，也就是那个有名的废材万尘。
即使，清风宗有手段能让万尘修炼，也不过才几天的时间，这万尘最多能突破练体二重，这样的实力恐怕第一轮就会被淘汰。
“借你吉言。这颗丹药赏你了。”秦叶曲指一弹，一颗香气四溢的丹药落到管家的手中。
管家定睛一看，认出是一颗极品的练体丹，神色一惊，如此极品的练体丹都能拿得出来送人，与之相比，城主府送来的这些礼品显得有些小气家子了。
随后管家一脸惊喜，这极品练体丹价值不菲，对他修炼帮助很大。
“多谢秦宗主赏赐。”管家激动地道谢。
content_en:
"Sect Master Qin, the city lord sent a young man here this time. In addition to giving gifts, there are more important things to inform Sect Master Qin." The steward said.
"What's the matter?" Qin Ye nodded slightly, noncommittal.
"Qingfeng City will hold a sect ranking competition in seven days. The city lord specially asked someone to inform Sect Master Qin to participate." The steward said.
In the sect ranking competition, Qin Ye naturally knew that in the last sect ranking competition, Qingfeng Sect was at the bottom, and was later kicked out by the six major sects.
Calculating that it will be held in two years, how can it be brought forward?
"Did the city lord tell me the reason for holding it in advance?" Qin Ye asked.
"The city lord didn't say anything, but this is the order passed down by Marquis Yangling, and the city lord can only obey it." The steward replied.
Qin Ye nodded slightly. He had heard of Yanglinghou. He was a famous general in the Qin Dynasty. He was awarded the title of Yanglinghou for his military exploits. Qingfeng City was under the jurisdiction of Yanglinghou.
As for the reason for Yanglinghou to pass down the order, it is not important to Qin Ye, as long as he does not offend him, if he dares to offend him, he will teach him how to behave, even if it is the Marquis who holds real power.
The Sect Ranking Competition is for young disciples under the age of 30 to participate. The City Lord's Mansion and participating sects will set generous rewards. This may be a good experience for other sects, but it is not for Qingfeng Sect.
Qin Ye didn't like that reward at all.
Therefore, Qin Ye refused directly: "I know, please let the housekeeper make this trip. I, the Qingfeng Sect, will not participate..."
When Qin Ye said this, the system prompt sounded suddenly.
"Ding, a new mission is activated. Please lead the disciples in the sect to participate in the sect ranking competition and win first place. The mission rewards ten blind boxes."
Qin Ye's body suddenly trembled. The ten blind boxes will definitely draw out good things. Isn't it the sect ranking competition? How difficult is it to get first place?
This sect ranked first in the competition, and he wanted it.
It’s useless for anyone to come.
"Sect Master Qin, you haven't finished what you just said, please continue."
The butler said respectfully.
"What I'm talking about is that Qingfeng Sect will definitely go to the sect ranking competition and win the first place." Qin Ye came back to his senses and changed his words.
Butler: "(⊙﹏⊙)"
That's not what you said just now.
"I just wish Qingfeng Sect success and all your wishes come true." The housekeeper congratulated, but he felt a little disapproving in his heart.
Although Qin Ye is an innately powerful person, the outside world has long known about the situation of Qingfeng Sect. There are only a few people in the entire Qingfeng Sect, and there is only one disciple, and he was just recruited, that is, the famous good-for-nothing Wanchen.
Even if the Qingfeng Sect had the means to enable Wan Chen to practice, it would only take a few days. Wan Chen could at most break through to the second level of physical training. With such strength, he would probably be eliminated in the first round.
"I'd like to thank you for your good words. I'll reward you with this elixir." Qin Ye flicked his fingers, and a fragrant elixir fell into the steward's hands.
The housekeeper took a closer look and recognized it as a top-quality body-training pill. He looked shocked. Such a top-quality body-training pill could be given away. In comparison, these gifts from the city lord's palace seemed a bit stingy.
Then the butler looked surprised. This top-quality body training elixir was worth a lot of money and would be of great help to his practice.
"Thank you, Master Qin, for the reward." The steward thanked him excitedly.
